notes.subject: עקבי
notes.rationale: 'ol slok bilong mi' (my heels) — Heb. 'my heels' meaning 'my steps/tracks'; versions split between 'heels' (ylt) and 'steps' (kjv).

notes.subject: נפשי
notes.rationale: Hebrew nefesh is throat/breath/life-force, rendered 'bel bilong mi', not 'soul'.

notes.subject: ⟨yet⟩
notes.rationale: Reflexive 'yet' added: Hebrew 'they hide' implies hiding themselves.

notes.subject: יגורו
notes.rationale: Root גור here 'gather/lurk' (from turning aside to sojourn); versions render 'gather' or 'conspire' (bsb).

translation: Ol i bringimap olgeta, ol i haitem ol ⟨yet⟩; ol i lukautim ol slok bilong mi, taim ol i wetim bel bilong mi.
